Ultimately, your enjoyment of it will come down to how much you enjoy poetic imagery. There's not much in the way of plot or character. I read it for a class alongside the Odyssey and then James Joyce's Ulysses. Of those, I'd say the Divine Comedy was the least memorable or interesting.
